title: Hide no poor results
statement: Tie every piece of work to its student, content and attempt, and show results openly, poor ones included.
detail: The delivery platform the reading project builds for makes this a non-negotiable for every app: the platform must be able to attribute work to student, content and attempt, results are surfaced to students and families, and apps cannot hide poor performance (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0032-principles.qmd`). Apps that fail to emit the required learning signals are not eligible for integration (the same file).

evidence.quote: **Emit learning events and keep outcomes transparent.** The platform must be able to attribute work to student, content, and attempt.
